attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Presumably the other two hundred-odd days of the year are spent planning it.","severity":"minor","reason":"framed as a guess, and the arithmetic is vague; day 376 of the year is odd but not a claimed fact, so only a weak concern"},{"span":"Their recently released crewmate's tales of kindness clearly did not travel far up the gangplank.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a cause/consequence link between the released crewmate and the raid, stated as fact ('clearly')"},{"span":"Otherwise, Jugust is quiet on the rim.","severity":"minor","reason":"states a status of the whole rim not given in the briefing"}],"voice":4,"clarity":3,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"The dry voice is consistent and the lead item matches the briefing, but it ties the raid to the released Corsair's tales as if causal, and the closing joke about 'two hundred-odd days' is muddled.
